questions.question: A rejected asylum seeker has worked legally for years, speaks Swedish and is well established. Should work-based residence sometimes replace deportation?

answers.text: Rarely; asylum decisions should normally be enforced.
No; rejected asylum claims should lead to departure.
answers.text_sv: Nej; avslag bör leda till att personen lämnar landet.

questions.dont_know_explainer: This tests whether establishment in Sweden should sometimes alter the consequence of a rejected asylum case.
questions.question_sv: En person har fått avslag på asyl men arbetat lagligt i flera år, talar svenska och är etablerad. Bör arbete ibland kunna ersätta utvisning?

questions.question: Would you support a policing tool that probably reduces gang violence but also causes a meaningful increase in surveillance of innocent people?

answers.text: Only if tightly limited and independently supervised.
answers.text_sv: Endast om verktyget är strikt begränsat och oberoende granskat.

answers.text: Yes if evidence of effectiveness is strong.
answers.text_sv: Ja, om det finns starka bevis för att det fungerar.

answers.text: Yes; serious violence justifies the intrusion.

questions.dont_know_explainer: Security tools can create benefits for public safety while imposing privacy costs on people not suspected of crimes.
questions.question_sv: Skulle du stödja ett polisverktyg som sannolikt minskar gängvåld men också ökar övervakningen av oskyldiga?

questions.question: Should municipalities be required to approve significantly more housing even when existing residents strongly oppose development?

answers.text: No; local democratic control should dominate.
answers.text_sv: Nej; lokal demokratisk kontroll bör väga tyngst.

answers.text: Often yes when regional housing need is high.
answers.text_sv: Ofta ja, när det regionala bostadsbehovet är stort.

answers.text: Yes; local vetoes should be sharply limited.
answers.text_sv: Ja; lokala veton bör begränsas kraftigt.

questions.dont_know_explainer: Housing shortages can create conflict between local residents' preferences and regional/national supply needs.
questions.question_sv: Bör kommuner tvingas godkänna betydligt fler bostäder även när befintliga boende är starkt emot?

questions.question: Should patients be allowed to use public funding to choose a provider in another region or a private provider when waiting times are long?

answers.text: Yes under clear quality and cost rules.
answers.text_sv: Ja, med tydliga kvalitets- och kostnadsregler.

answers.text: Yes broadly; patient choice should dominate provider ownership.
answers.text_sv: Ja i bred omfattning; patientens val bör väga tyngre än ägarformen.

questions.dont_know_explainer: This concerns whether public financing should follow patient choice across provider boundaries.
questions.question_sv: Bör patienter kunna använda offentlig finansiering hos en annan region eller privat vårdgivare när väntetiderna är långa?

questions.question: If school choice increases parental satisfaction but also increases segregation between schools, what should take priority?

answers.text_sv: Minska valfriheten för att minska segregationen.

answers.text: Keep choice but address segregation through other policies.
answers.text_sv: Behåll valfriheten men motverka segregationen på andra sätt.

answers.text: Choice should remain even if segregation increases.
answers.text_sv: Valfriheten bör bestå även om segregationen ökar.

questions.dont_know_explainer: School choice can create benefits for individual families while changing the composition of schools.
questions.question_sv: Om skolval ökar föräldrars nöjdhet men också segregationen mellan skolor, vad bör väga tyngst?

questions.question: A party agrees with you on the economy, crime and healthcare but strongly wants government to promote social values you oppose. How much should that matter?

answers.text: Hardly at all; those issues should not affect my vote.
answers.text_sv: Nästan inte alls; sådana frågor bör inte påverka min röst.

answers.text: It could rule the party out for me.
answers.text_sv: Det skulle kunna utesluta partiet för mig.

questions.dont_know_explainer: This does not measure whether you are progressive or conservative. It measures whether large social-values disagreement can be a voting dealbreaker.
questions.question_sv: Ett parti håller med dig om ekonomi, brott och vård men vill starkt driva sociala värderingar du motsätter dig. Hur mycket bör det påverka?

questions.question: A party matches most of your domestic policies but wants much deeper EU integration than you do. How much should that matter?

answers.text: It could rule the party out.
answers.text_sv: Det skulle kunna utesluta partiet för mig.

questions.dont_know_explainer: This measures how much a large EU-governance disagreement should affect your final voting fit.
questions.question_sv: Ett parti matchar de flesta av dina inrikespolitiska åsikter men vill ha mycket djupare EU-integration än du. Hur mycket bör det påverka?

questions.question: A party matches you on most issues but its climate policy would significantly raise your household costs. How much should that matter?

answers.text: It could rule the party out.
answers.text_sv: Det skulle kunna utesluta partiet för mig.

questions.dont_know_explainer: This measures dealbreaker sensitivity to climate-related household costs rather than your climate position itself.
questions.question_sv: Ett parti matchar dig i det mesta men dess klimatpolitik skulle höja dina levnadskostnader märkbart. Hur mycket bör det påverka?

questions.question: A party matches you economically but is far more restrictive or far more open on immigration than you are. How much should that matter?

answers.text: It could rule the party out.
answers.text_sv: Det skulle kunna utesluta partiet för mig.

questions.dont_know_explainer: This measures whether immigration disagreement is merely a preference or a potential veto.
questions.question_sv: Ett parti matchar dig ekonomiskt men är mycket mer restriktivt eller öppet i invandringsfrågor än du. Hur mycket bör det påverka?

questions.question: A party agrees with you on sentencing but supports surveillance powers you consider excessive. How much should that matter?

answers.text: It could rule the party out.
answers.text_sv: Det skulle kunna utesluta partiet för mig.

questions.dont_know_explainer: This measures whether civil-liberties disagreement has special veto power in your voting decision.
questions.question_sv: Ett parti håller med dig om straff men stödjer övervakningsbefogenheter du tycker går för långt. Hur mycket bör det påverka?

questions.question: Which description of a good government is closest to yours?

answers.text: Actively reshape society toward greater equality and security.
answers.text_sv: Aktivt forma samhället mot större jämlikhet och trygghet.

answers.text: Use government pragmatically wherever it clearly improves outcomes.
answers.text_sv: Använd staten pragmatiskt där den tydligt förbättrar resultat.

answers.text: Do a smaller number of core things very well.
answers.text_sv: Gör ett mindre antal kärnuppgifter riktigt bra.

answers.text: Leave as many decisions as possible to individuals, markets and civil society.
answers.text_sv: Lämna så många beslut som möjligt till individer, marknader och civilsamhälle.

questions.dont_know_explainer: This is a broad check on your preferred governing philosophy.
questions.question_sv: Vilken beskrivning av en bra regering ligger närmast din syn?

questions.question: Would you accept somewhat higher economic inequality if median living standards rose faster?

answers.text: Definitely; absolute prosperity matters much more than inequality.
answers.text_sv: Absolut; absolut välstånd betyder mycket mer än själva skillnaderna.

questions.dont_know_explainer: This separates relative inequality from absolute improvements in living standards.
questions.question_sv: Skulle du acceptera något större ekonomiska skillnader om medianens levnadsstandard ökade snabbare?

questions.question: If you could cut tax on work by increasing tax on expensive property, would you support the swap?

answers.text: No; keep work taxes higher rather than raise property tax.
answers.text_sv: Nej; behåll hellre högre skatt på arbete än att höja fastighetsskatt.

answers.text: Yes; shift taxation away from work toward property.
answers.text_sv: Ja; flytta beskattning från arbete till fastighet.

questions.dont_know_explainer: Different tax bases have different effects. This question tests whether you care more about the total tax level or where taxes fall.
questions.question_sv: Om du kunde sänka skatt på arbete genom att höja skatt på dyra fastigheter, skulle du stödja det?

questions.question: Should a welfare system be allowed to be quite generous if benefits are strongly tied to previous work and contributions?

answers.text: No; generosity should be limited regardless.
answers.text_sv: Nej; generositeten bör vara begränsad oavsett.

answers.text: Yes; contribution-based generosity is a good model.
answers.text_sv: Ja; generösa men inbetalningsbaserade system är en bra modell.

questions.dont_know_explainer: Generosity and qualification are separate questions: a system can be generous but contribution-based.
questions.question_sv: Kan ett välfärdssystem vara ganska generöst om förmånerna är starkt kopplade till tidigare arbete och inbetalningar?

questions.question: When choosing a government, what should matter most?

answers.text: Reducing inequality and expanding social protection.
answers.text_sv: Minska ojämlikhet och bygga ut social trygghet.

answers.text: Economic freedom, security and strong core institutions.
answers.text_sv: Ekonomisk frihet, trygghet och starka kärninstitutioner.

answers.text: Maximum individual freedom and minimum government.
answers.text_sv: Maximal individuell frihet och minimal stat.

questions.dont_know_explainer: This broad question is deliberately low-weight. It is mainly used as a consistency check rather than a decisive score.
questions.question_sv: När du väljer regering, vad bör väga tyngst?
